title: Learning What to Keep: Transfer-Aware Personal Skill Learning from User Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.19380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User feedback enables LLMs to refine reusable personalized skills, but often mixes persistent preferences with request-specific corrections. Indiscriminately retaining both risks negative transfer, motivating selective retention at the level of individual requirements. We frame this challenge as selective transfer over atomic rules and propose SkillGrain, a framework for learning reusable personalized skills from user feedback. SkillGrain decomposes feedback into independently actionable rules, predicts their transferability, and retains only those suitable for future requests. To learn these decisions, we combine rubric-guided skill rewards with fine-grained credit assignment that separately evaluates rule content and retention decisions. We further jointly optimize skill induction and skill-conditioned generation through reinforcement learning, ensuring that learned skills support downstream personalization. translated_title: 学习该保留什么：基于迁移感知的从用户反馈中学习个性化技能
translated_abstract: 用户反馈使大型语言模型（LLM）能够改进可复用的个性化技能，但反馈中往往混杂着持久性偏好与针对特定请求的修正。不加区分地同时保留二者会带来负迁移的风险，因此需要在个体需求层面进行选择性保留。我们将这一挑战构建为原子规则上的选择性迁移问题，并提出了 SkillGrain——一个从用户反馈中学习可复用个性化技能的框架。SkillGrain 将反馈分解为可独立执行的规则，预测各规则的可迁移性，并仅保留那些适用于未来请求的规则。为了学习这些决策，我们将基于评分准则引导的技能奖励与细粒度信用分配相结合，分别评估规则内容和保留决策。我们进一步通过强化学习联合优化技能归纳与基于技能条件的生成，确保所学技能能够支持下游的个性化任务。我们构建了一个基准（原文在此截断）
tldr: 提出 SkillGrain 框架，将用户反馈分解为可独立执行的原子规则并预测其可迁移性，通过基于评分准则的奖励、细粒度信用分配以及强化学习联合优化，从用户反馈中选择性地保留真正可迁移的个性化技能。
en_tdlr: SkillGrain decomposes user feedback into independently actionable atomic rules, predicts their transferability, and leverages rubric-guided rewards with fine-grained credit assignment and reinforcement learning to selectively retain transferable personal skills for downstream personalization.
